sources.memo: 08 Rightsizing - Rightsizing Update Scenario Release Memo.pdf (October 5, 2026)

pathway_to_high_school.all: Solid arrow: all students continue to the same school.
pathway_to_high_school.some: Dashed arrow: only some students continue to this high school (split pathway).

legend.continues_to: null = continues to this high school; otherwise the named high school.
legend.program: neighborhood, or the immersion program the link carries
legend.changed: true when the link differs from the current feeder pattern

caveats: Only feeder-relevant changes are applied. The memo counts 38 (A) / 34 (B) boundary changes; small boundary edits that move streets between schools are not itemised and change enrollment, not school-to-school links.
Shares are given only where PPS states them (Maplewood, Stephenson, Buckman). Other new split feeders have no published shares.
One slide 39 link (Mt. Tabor -> Cleveland) conflicts with the maps and is not applied; see changes.
